expected_result.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

scoring_rubric.description: Newly generated evidence recovers the scoped paper conclusion. A conflicting ranking, phase sequence, barrier trend, selectivity, ensemble effect, or bonding interpretation is not a reproduction.
Correctly composes the required software stages, passes artifacts between them, and respects dependency, retry, and stopping logic.
Validates chemical identity, convergence, stationary-point type, wavefunction or periodic-output quality, and rejects invalid branches.
Follows the supplied paper-reconstructed protocol and clearly labels any controlled, version-compatible substitution.
Uses consistent units, reference states, normalization, statistics, and uncertainty estimates.
Links every conclusion to artifacts and separates computation, paper targets, inference, failures, and unresolved uncertainty.

critical_failures: No real periodic DFT calculation was executed.
Adsorption energies used unmatched cells or reference states.
Frozen fragments were confused with relaxed references.
LOBSTER values were copied from the paper or interpreted without spilling evidence.
judge_instructions: Evaluate this as a multi-software paper reproduction. Do not award conclusion credit for copied paper values, invalid intermediates, or numerically plausible results unsupported by artifacts from this run. The paper-conclusion criterion is the majority of the score. Apply every evidence gate.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

gates.description: Both systems use compatible adsorbed, slab, molecule, and frozen-fragment references.
Binding, deformation, and interaction terms close algebraically.
Pd-C bonding metrics derive from valid outputs with acceptable or qualified spilling.

verified_components: Published adsorbed and isolated structures are available
unresolved_requirements: The optPBE-vdW settings require a production reference run through the VASP additional-INCAR contract.
Fresh LOBSTER generation requires the native-job layer.
The two published systems use different surface-cell sizes and must be assessed with matched per-system references rather than direct raw-energy subtraction.
